topic: Student-led protests over the state of the school system (teacher shortages, resources), expanding to cost of living, wages and pensions; nationwide marches 17 Oct (550,000 official / 800,000 organisers) with clashes, 1,800 arrested
scale: 550,000 at 110 demonstrations nationwide incl. 110,000 in Paris on 17 Oct 2026 (organisers claim 800,000); ~25,000 students at Bastille on 8 Oct 2026; schools blockaded
quote1: An estimated 25,000 students thronged the square in the east of the capital, with some climbing the monument at its centre, which commemorates France’s 1830 July revolution, while waving the tricolour flag and singing the Marseillaise.
quote2: The mobilisation followed student protests over conditions in French schools, expanding to include purchasing power, wages, pensions and public services.
